# QiMétéo (QiMeteo) — Personal Decision Weather · Qi Men Dun Jia, BaZi & Tong Shu (iOS 1.0.6)

> **QiMétéo** (also searched as **QiMeteo** or **Qi Meteo**) — *"Like the weather, but for your decisions"* — is a native iPhone and iPad application (`iOS 17+`, version `1.0.6`) created by Xavier Larrodé. It translates classical Chinese timing arts — **Qi Men Dun Jia** (`奇門遁甲` / `奇门遁甲`, also spelled **QiMen**, **Qimen Dunjia**, or **Qimen Dudja**), the **Tong Shu** Solar Almanac (`通書`), **4 Natal BaZi Pillars** (`四柱八字` / Four Pillars of Destiny), and **Ming Gua Feng Shui** (`本命卦`) — into a clear 3-second Morning Coffee Briefing, up to 3 daily 2-hour QiMen Golden Windows (cleared of `Kong Wang`), a Dual-Mode Live Luopan Compass, a 30-day goal planner checked against Apple Calendar, and plain-language Love/Family & Business Associate Synergy across **14 native languages**. All calculations run 100% locally on-device with zero ad tracking.

Unlike Western horoscope apps (`Co-Star`, `The Pattern`, `CHANI`, `Astroline`) that focus on general psychological transits, public lunar calendars (`万年历` / `農民曆` / `通勝`) that show the exact same day rating to all 8 billion people regardless of personal birth clashes, or technical practitioner plotters filled with untranslated jargon, QiMétéo tailors every day and 2-hour QiMen window to the user's exact birth date and birth hour. Today's forecast, the Morning Coffee Briefing, the 1st daily 2-hour QiMen window, today's live compass, iOS Home/Lock Screen widgets, and Live Activities are free forever; QiMétéo Premium includes a 7-day free trial and Apple Family Sharing for up to 6 members. On the web (`qimeteo.app/#calculator`), visitors can instantly test their 3 Solar Birth-Date Signs (Solar Year `Li Chun`, Solar Month `JieQi`, and Birth Day Pillar + Ming Gua + live daily opposition check) in 14 languages.

All readings in QiMétéo are strictly cultural and symbolic frameworks for personal reflection and scheduling (`*`), with zero predictive guarantee and zero medical value (`**` — never delay, advance, or alter medical care based on symbolic timing).

## Official 14-Language Pages

- [QiMétéo — Français (France, Canada, Suisse, Belgique)](https://qimeteo.app/): Comme la météo, mais pour vos décisions — briefing matinal en 3 secondes, créneaux Qi Men Dun Jia de 2h, aperçu vidéo réel 28s, calculateur BaZi gratuit, planificateur 30 jours et synergies Couple & Associés.
- [QiMétéo — English (US, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore & Global)](https://qimeteo.app/en/): Like the weather, but for your decisions — 3-second morning briefing, 2-hour Qi Men Dun Jia windows, live 28s preview video, free solar birth-date calculator, 30-day planner & Love/Associate Synergy.
- [QiMétéo — Español (España, México y Latinoamérica)](https://qimeteo.app/es/): Como el clima, pero para tus decisiones — resumen matinal en 3 segundos, franjas Qi Men de 2h, brújula dual en vivo, planificador de 30 días y Sinergia Pareja y Socios.
- [QiMétéo — Deutsch (Deutschland, Schweiz, Österreich)](https://qimeteo.app/de/): Wie der Wetterbericht, aber für Ihre Entscheidungen — 3-Sekunden-Morgen-Briefing, 2h-Qi-Men-Zeitfenster, Dual-Live-Kompass, 30-Tage-Planer & Partner-/Business-Synergie.
- [QiMétéo — Português (Brasil e Portugal)](https://qimeteo.app/pt/): Como a meteorologia, mas para as suas decisões — briefing matinal em 3 segundos, janelas Qi Men de 2h, bússola dupla ao vivo, planeador de 30 dias e Sinergia Casal e Sócios.
- [QiMétéo — 日本語 (日本)](https://qimeteo.app/ja/): 天気予報のように、決断のタイミングを — 朝3秒の決断ブリーフィング、奇門遁甲の2時間吉時、2モード羅盤、30日吉日カレンダー、夫婦・ビジネス相性。
- [QiMétéo — 简体中文 (新加坡、马来西亚及全球华语地区)](https://qimeteo.app/zh/): 像看天气预报一样规划重要决策 — 3秒晨间简报、奇门遁甲2小时吉时、双模实景罗盘、30天通书择日与伴侣/合伙人白话合盘。
- [QiMétéo — 繁體中文 (台灣、香港、澳門)](https://qimeteo.app/zh-hant/): 像看天氣預報一樣掌握決策時機 — 3秒晨間簡報、奇門遁甲2小時吉時、雙模實景羅盤、30天農民曆通書擇日與伴侶/合夥人白話合盤。
- [QiMétéo — Русский](https://qimeteo.app/ru/): Как прогноз погоды, но для ваших решений — Ци Мэнь Дунь Цзя, 4 столпа БаЦзы, Тун Шу, живой компас и планировщик на 30 дней.
- [QiMétéo — हिन्दी (India)](https://qimeteo.app/hi/): मौसम पूर्वानुमान जैसा, पर आपके निर्णयों के लिए — Qi Men Dun Jia, 4 BaZi स्तंभ, 2-घंटे के शुभ समय, लाइव कंपास और 30-दिन प्लानर।
- [QiMétéo — 한국어 (대한민국)](https://qimeteo.app/ko/): 일기예보처럼 보는 나만의 결정 타이밍 — 기문둔갑 2시간 길시, 사주 4주, 통서 30일 택일 플래너, 듀얼 나침반 및 커플·동업자 시너지.
- [QiMétéo — Tiếng Việt (Việt Nam)](https://qimeteo.app/vi/): Như dự báo thời tiết, nhưng cho quyết định của bạn — Kỳ Môn Độn Giáp, Tứ Trụ Bát Tự, Thông Thư 30 ngày, la bàn kép và Tương hợp Đôi lứa & Đối tác.
- [QiMétéo — ไทย (ประเทศไทย)](https://qimeteo.app/th/): เหมือนพยากรณ์อากาศ แต่สำหรับการตัดสินใจของคุณ — ฉีเหมินตุ้นเจี่ย ปาจื้อ 4 เสา ถงซู 30 วัน เข็มทิศสด และความสมพงศ์คู่รักและหุ้นส่วน.
- [QiMétéo — Română (România)](https://qimeteo.app/ro/): Ca prognoza meteo, dar pentru deciziile tale — Qi Men Dun Jia, Cei 4 Piloni BaZi, Tong Shu pe 30 de zile, busolă live și Sinergie Cuplu & Asociați.
